fields.tag: u8 ASCII kernel phase A-H or T high clock half; busy guest1/2 in handoff

phase_contract: PIO is incomplete on initial exit. Response filled first; KVM_RUN immediate_exit=1 reentry must return EINTR; only then registers/RAM observed or event dispatched. Completion-only reentry creates no separate time/event/RNG charge. Clock cost is the explicit clock read semantic charge. IRQ windows are administrative legal injection opportunities, not clock charges.
extension_needed: observe every natural IO/MMIO/HLT/IRQ-window and counter/debug stop; serialize initial RAM then dirty pages; GPR plus full guest CPU/KVM state and plain device/world data. Internal correction has no world charge; executed guest instructions remain counted.
